# OfficeCleaningCost.com

> Independent US commercial office cleaning cost estimator, 150-city rate benchmarks, janitorial quote comparison matrix, and Amazon US facility supply guides.

## Core Tools
- [Office Cleaning Cost Calculator](https://officecleaningcost.com/office-cleaning-cost-calculator/): Estimates per-visit, monthly, and annual janitorial budgets by square footage, restroom count, flooring type, cleaning frequency, US city multiplier, and scope add-ons.
- [Janitorial Quote Comparison Tool](https://officecleaningcost.com/compare-cleaning-quotes/): Side-by-side bid audit checking ISSA production hours, consumables inclusion, liability insurance, janitorial bonding, and contract terms.

## Editorial Silos (1,000 SEO Guides + 200 Commercial Supply Reviews)
- `/office-cleaning-cost-guides/`: Cost per square foot, hourly rates, flat-rate pricing, minimum charges.
- `/city-cleaning-costs/`: Localized pricing benchmarks across 150 US metro markets.
- `/facility-cleaning-costs/`: Medical, dental, legal, coworking, financial, warehouse, and multi-tenant suites.
- `/cleaning-services-and-tasks/`: Restrooms, breakrooms, carpet extraction, VCT strip & wax, interior glass, day porters, post-construction.
- `/cleaning-frequency-and-schedules/`: Monthly, biweekly, 1x–7x weekly, and day vs after-hours night crew pricing.
- `/flooring-and-surface-cleaning-costs/`: Commercial carpet, VCT/LVT, ceramic tile & grout, hardwood, and polished concrete.
- `/comparing-quotes-and-contracts/`: RFP checklists, scope-of-work audits, insurance/bonding, and contract red flags.
- `/in-house-vs-outsourced-cleaning/`: Payroll burden, equipment depreciation, supply budgets, and break-even headcount.
- `/green-cleaning-and-osha-compliance/`: Green Seal, EPA Safer Choice, OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens, and indoor air quality.
- `/commercial-vacuums-and-floor-machines/`, `/janitorial-carts-mops-and-tools/`, `/restroom-and-breakroom-dispensers/`, `/commercial-cleaning-chemicals-and-mats/`: 200 commercial equipment and supply buying guides linked to Amazon.com (`officecleaningcost-20`).
